panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: Sum of pod CPU requests / allocatable CPU on the selected nodes. This is what the scheduler fills.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_node_allocation" and (r._field == "cpu_requests_m" or r._field == "cpu_allocatable_m"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r.cpu_requests_m) / float(v: r.cpu_allocatable_m) * 100.0}))

panels.title: GPU slots in use
panels.description: gpu.intel.com/i915 slots requested / advertised (4 per node by the Intel device plugin).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_node_allocation" and (r._field == "gpu_requests" or r._field == "gpu_capacity"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.gpu_capacity > 0 then float(v: r.gpu_requests) / float(v: r.gpu_capacity) * 100.0 else 0.0}))

panels.title: Per node: requests vs actual usage
CPU requested % of allocatable
panels.description: What the scheduler sees. The descheduler's LowNodeUtilization thresholds (35 % / 60 %) apply to this number on the three servers.

  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.cpu_requests_m and exists r.cpu_allocatable_m and r.cpu_allocatable_m > 0)

panels.title: Workload requests vs usage (latest)
panels.description: Usage / request below ~20 % = over-requested (reserves capacity it does not use); above 100 % = under-requested (the scheduler under-counts it). Idle portfolio apps are expected to sit low.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_workload_allocation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.namespace, set: ${namespace:json}))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["namespace", "owner_kind", "workload"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({namespace: r.namespace, workload: r.workload, kind: r.owner_kind, pods: r.pods, nodes: r.nodes,
      cpu_req_m: r.cpu_requests_m, cpu_use_m: if exists r.cpu_usage_m then r.cpu_usage_m else 0,
      cpu_eff: if exists r.cpu_usage_m and r.cpu_requests_m > 0 then float(v: r.cpu_usage_m) / float(v: r.cpu_requests_m) * 100.0 else 0.0,
      mem_req: r.mem_requests_b, mem_use: if exists r.mem_usage_b then r.mem_usage_b else 0,
      mem_eff: if exists r.mem_usage_b and r.mem_requests_b > 0 then float(v: r.mem_usage_b) / float(v: r.mem_requests_b) * 100.0 else 0.0,
      mem_limit: r.mem_limits_b, gpu: r.gpu_requests}))
  |> sort(columns: ["mem_req"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_workload_allocation" and r._field == "pods" and r.owner_kind != "Job" and r.owner_kind != "Pod")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.namespace, set: ${namespace:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["namespace", "workload"])

panels.title: Events by reason
panels.description: Scheduled, FailedScheduling, Evicted (incl. descheduler), Preempted, SuccessfulRescale, NodeNotReady, OOMKilling...

targets.query:

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_allocation_event" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.namespace, set: ${namespace:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["reason"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Scheduled pods by node
panels.description: Where the scheduler is putting new pods.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_allocation_event" and r.reason == "Scheduled" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "k8s-allocation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k8s_allocation_event")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.namespace, set: ${namespace:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.reason =~ /${reason:regex}/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "reason", "type", "namespace", "object_kind", "object_name", "node", "descheduler", "count", "message"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 300)
